description: This file is a test application for broadcasting tuner functionality, including initialization, deinitialization, tuner creation, switching, and tuning streams. It contains a main function with a command-line interface to control tuner operations and manages a list of stream configurations.

classes.name: streamInfo
classes.description: A class representing broadcast stream parameters such as frequency, modulation, symbol rate, FEC, and spectral inversion.
